cell_type.evidence: Plasma samples were depleted of high-abundant proteins, and proteomic analysis was performed using high-resolution isoelectric focusing (HiRIEF) coupled with liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), with relative quantification by isobaric tandem mass tags (TMT16-plex).

disease_state.evidence: inferred: The present study cohort consists of a retrospectively selected subset of the PEX-LC cohort, which has been described previously.

material_type.evidence: inferred: Plasma samples were depleted of high-abundant proteins, and proteomic analysis was performed using high-resolution isoelectric focusing (HiRIEF) coupled with liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), with relative quantification by isobaric tandem mass tags (TMT16-plex).

sample_source.evidence: Here, we present an in-depth proteomic profiling of pre-diagnostic plasma samples from 114 individuals with suspected lung cancer, including 57 patients diagnosed with stage III-IV lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and 57 non-cancer controls.

sex.evidence: DAAs between females (N = 37) and males (N = 51) were performed using a two-sided Welch’s t test, with males as the reference group.
